goal_step.title: What brings you to Riff Quest?
goal_step.description: Pick where to start. Everything else stays one click away.

plan_step.title: Pick a plan to start with
plan_step.description: Short routines where the timer walks you through each exercise. Nothing starts until you press Play — with the mic for live feedback, or without it.

some.description: Chords and simple songs, I want to get better

experienced.label: I've played for years
experienced.description: Comfortable on the neck, I want to keep improving

journey.label: Follow the Learning Path
journey.description: Learn guitar from scratch, one step at a time

plans.label: Practice with exercise plans
plans.description: Ready-made routines with a timer that guides you

songs.label: Learn songs and track them
songs.description: Save songs you want to play and see your progress

roadmap.label: Follow a roadmap to a goal
roadmap.description: A step-by-step path, like playing in the style of your hero

log.label: Log the practice I already do

intro.title: Welcome to Riff Quest
intro.description: Two minutes on what this is and how it works.

first_song.title: Add a song you want to play
first_song.description: Keep track of songs you want to learn, are learning, or already know.
first_song.step1: Go to the Songs page and click this button:
first_song.step2: Type the artist and title of any song you'd love to play. Already in the library? Just pick the match. Not there yet? No problem — you're adding it:
first_song.step3: Tell the app where this song is on your journey. Later you can practice it section by section and watch your mastery grow:

reward.title: Draw your first guitar
reward.description: You played your first session — claim your Fame and open a case.
reward.body: That's exactly enough to open a case in the Arsenal. Claim it and you'll land there ready to pick your guitar.
